verdicts.reason: A keeps the original top-to-bottom hierarchy (ribbon, logo, can, big headline, CTA), but the legal line is blown up almost to subhead size, jammed right under the headline, left with an orphaned 'Co., 2026.' and sitting over the maroon circle. B's split layout puts the can low-left on the circle, out of line with the text column. The LONGEST DAY SALE ribbon shrinks to a barely readable sliver in the bottom-right corner, and the legal copy runs into the grey circle.

A has a strong headline and CTA, but the product can and SOLSTICE logo shrink to tiny icons at the bottom edge, so the key imagery and brand become trivial, and the legal line is promoted to a subhead. B keeps the can and logo prominent, with a clear order from headline to CTA. Its flaws are a cramped, oversized legal line wedged between headline and button over the circle, plus the orphaned 'Co., 2026.'.
